fire: Out on the mudflats we counted about two hundred Brent geese.
The memo was signed by Brent Collins, the plant manager.
Oil traders watched Brent crude climb above ninety dollars.
My cousin Brent drove us to the airport at dawn.
Analysts expect Brent prices to fall again next quarter.
In the second half, Brent scored twice for the visitors.
A pair of Brent geese landed on the frozen pond.
The novel follows a detective called Brent Harlow.
